marketing_description: The DeWALT MAX XR Series DCF860B Cordless High Torque Impact Driver features a 3-Speed High Torque setting and a 1/4-In. Hex Quick-Release Chuck. This tool has a brushless motor and offers a speed rating of 0 to 3800 RPM. It is part of the MAX XR Series and has a torque rating of 2500 in-lb.
